/**
 * MONTHLIV's places: every branch that is open or opening soon, one place per room type, and
 * MONTHLIV in Jeju. Generated by scripts/make-listings.py from the branch list there — edit that
 * script, not this file. Names, areas, stations, room types and opening dates are real; prices are
 * examples, and nobody has reviewed a branch here yet. All of it will come from the database later
 * (see README, "다음 단계"). Prices follow src/lib/pricing.ts: a 1-night price, stay-length
 * discounts, one cleaning fee.
 */
import type { Locale } from "@/i18n/routing";
import { defaultDiscounts, type Discounts } from "@/lib/pricing";

export type Tone = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;

/** Text in several languages. English is used when a language is missing. */
export type Text = { ko: string; en: string } & Partial<Record<Locale, string>>;

export function pick(text: Text, locale: string): string {
  return text[locale as Locale] ?? text.en;
}

/**
 * A photo in public/photos/<listing id>/, made by scripts/photos.mjs: `file` "01" is
 * 01-640.webp, 01-1280.webp and 01-1920.webp. `width` and `height` are the largest size's.
 */
export type Photo = { file: string; width: number; height: number; alt: Text };

/** Amenities with a label in messages (listing.amenity.*). */
export type Amenity =
  | "bath"
  | "window"
  | "aircon"
  | "desk"
  | "fridge"
  | "bedding"
  | "wifi"
  | "laundry"
  | "kitchen"
  | "parcel"
  | "parking"
  | "garden"
  | "balcony"
  | "dogPlayground"
  | "petCafe";

/** How a place is reached from the nearest station or landmark. */
export type Travel = "walk" | "car";

export type Listing = {
  id: string;
  /** The branch the room belongs to; rooms of one branch share it. */
  branch: string;
  /** The branch's operating fee in basis points (1000 = 10%), taken off the partner's payout. */
  feeBps: number;
  /** Opening month (YYYY-MM) of a branch that hasn't opened yet; the day isn't fixed. */
  opens?: string;
  /** The room type's name within its branch (스탠다드 룸, 싱글룸 …). */
  room?: Text;
  /** The branch's neighbourhood, as it goes in the slogan: MONTHLY [ 성수 ] BY MONTHLIV. */
  place?: Text;
  /** Floor area in square metres. */
  size?: number;
  /** Colour of the photo slot when there are no photos. */
  tone: Tone;
  /** Price for one night, taxes included. */
  nightly: number;
  discounts: Discounts;
  /** Charged once per booking. */
  cleaning: number;
  /** Average guest rating out of 5 (★ 4.92); not shown while there are no reviews. */
  rating: number;
  /** 0 for a place nobody has reviewed yet: it shows as new. */
  reviews: number;
  /** Free cancellation until 3 pm, 7 days before check-in. */
  freeCancellation: boolean;
  /** Approximate position only: the exact address is shared after booking. */
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  title: Text;
  area: Text;
  /** Defaults to Seoul. */
  city?: Text;
  /** Nearest station, or a landmark where there is no subway. */
  station: Text;
  minutes: number;
  /** Defaults to walking. */
  by?: Travel;
  type: Text;
  /** Most guests a room takes: 1 for living solo, 2 or more for living together (함께살기). */
  guests: number;
  /** Longer text for the listing page. */
  description?: Text;
  /** Other places nearby, besides the station or landmark. */
  nearby?: { name: Text; minutes: number; by?: Travel }[];
  /**
   * Details of a real place. Sample places leave this out, and their pages show the sample
   * details from the design (photo slots, host, self check-in, amenities, reviews).
   */
  real?: {
    /** The cover first. */
    photos: Photo[];
    /** The photo page groups the photos by part of the place (files from `photos`). */
    spaces: { key: string; title: Text; note: Text; files: string[] }[];
    host: { name: Text; initial: Text; note: Text };
    /** First highlight on the listing page, in place of self check-in. */
    highlight: { title: Text; text: Text };
    /** Door code by app. Without it the pages promise no self check-in. */
    selfCheckIn: boolean;
    amenities: Amenity[];
    /** Shown only once a booking is confirmed. */
    address: Text;
  };
};

export const cities = {
  seoul: { ko: "서울", en: "Seoul", ja: "ソウル", "zh-CN": "首尔", de: "Seoul" },
  jeju: { ko: "제주", en: "Jeju", ja: "済州", "zh-CN": "济州", de: "Jeju" },
} satisfies Record<string, Text>;

export function cityOf(listing: Listing): Text {
  return listing.city ?? cities.seoul;
}

/** Sample places are self check-in, as in the design; real places say so themselves. */
export function hasSelfCheckIn(listing: Listing): boolean {
  return listing.real ? listing.real.selfCheckIn : true;
}

/** Widths scripts/photos.mjs makes of every photo. */
export const photoWidths = [640, 1280, 1920] as const;

export function photoSrc(listingId: string, photo: Photo, width: (typeof photoWidths)[number]): string {
  return `/photos/${listingId}/${photo.file}-${width}.webp`;
}

} satisfies Record<string, Text>;

const hostelDiscounts: Discounts = { week: 5, month: 15, season: 20 };

/**
 * Areas the search box knows until search comes from the database: a word from `words` in
 * "where" shows that area's places. More specific areas come first ("서울 성수동" is Seongsu).
 * `center` places the area's small map on the home page.
 */
export type SearchArea = {
  key: string;
  name: Text;
  words: readonly string[];
  ids: readonly string[];
  center: { lat: number; lng: number };
};

/** Every place in Seoul. */
const seoulIds = listings.filter((listing) => listing.branch !== "jeju").map((listing) => listing.id);

export const searchAreas: SearchArea[] = [
  {
    key: "jeju",
    name: cities.jeju,
    words: ["제주", "서귀포", "중문", "jeju", "seogwipo", "jungmun", "済州", "济州", "濟州", "西帰浦", "西归浦"],
    ids: ["monthliv-in-jeju"],
    center: { lat: 33.2604, lng: 126.4103 },
  },
/*@AREAS@*/
  {
    key: "seoul",
    name: cities.seoul,
    words: ["서울", "seoul", "ソウル", "首尔", "首爾"],
    ids: seoulIds,
    center: { lat: 37.5665, lng: 126.978 },
  },
];

export function findSearchArea(where: string | undefined): SearchArea | undefined {
  const text = where?.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!text) return undefined;
  return searchAreas.find((area) => area.words.some((word) => text.includes(word)));
}

export function getSearchArea(key: string): SearchArea | undefined {
  return searchAreas.find((area) => area.key === key);
}

/** The header's sections (한달살기, 스테이, 호스텔, 레지던스, 함께살기); each opens the search with its places. */
export const categories = ["month", "stay", "hostel", "residence", "together"] as const;
export type Category = (typeof categories)[number];

export function isCategory(value: unknown): value is Category {
  return categories.includes(value as Category);
}

/** Places in a section. */
export function categoryListings(category: Category): Listing[] {
  switch (category) {
    case "month":
      return listings.filter((listing) => listing.type === T.stay || listing.type === T.residence || listing.type === T.hotelStay);
    case "stay":
      return listings.filter((listing) => listing.type === T.stay);
    case "hostel":
      return listings.filter((listing) => listing.type === T.hostel);
    case "residence":
      return listings.filter((listing) => listing.type === T.residence || listing.type === T.hotelStay);
    case "together":
      return listings.filter((listing) => listing.guests >= 2);
  }
}

/** The sample search used across the first build: a month in Seongsu for one guest. */
export const sampleTrip = { from: "2026-11-02", to: "2026-11-30", guests: 1 } as const;

/** Short stays on the home page are priced for a weekend. */
export const weekendTrip = { from: "2026-11-13", to: "2026-11-15", guests: 1 } as const;

export function getListing(id: string): Listing | undefined {
  return listings.find((item) => item.id === id);
}

export function getListings(ids: readonly string[]): Listing[] {
  return ids.map((id) => getListing(id)).filter((item): item is Listing => Boolean(item));
}

/** The other room types of the same branch. */
export function siblingsOf(listing: Listing): Listing[] {
  return listings.filter((item) => item.branch === listing.branch && item.id !== listing.id);
}

/** The branch's name as guests see it: the title before the room ("성수 스테이"). */
export function branchName(listing: Listing, locale: string): string {
  return pick(listing.title, locale).split(" · ")[0];
}

/** Has the branch opened by `today` (YYYY-MM-DD)? Until its opening month is over, it counts as not yet. */
export function isOpen(listing: Listing, today: string): boolean {
  return !listing.opens || listing.opens < today.slice(0, 7);
}
